dedupe_keys.name: imda telecommunications statistics for singapore subscriptions broadband mobile data traffic and wireless sg hotspots

description: The Infocomm Media Development Authority, Singapore's telecommunications and media regulator, publishes national telecommunications statistics in two places. On the national open data portal data.gov.sg it maintains about 25 collections with long monthly and quarterly series: total mobile subscriptions by network technology and plan type from 1997 to August 2020 (3G counted from May 2005 and 4G from March 2013), residential wired broadband subscriptions by type (DSL, cable modem, fibre) from 2008 to 2019 and by speed band from 2011 to 2019, monthly mobile data usage from 2004 to 2019, SMS traffic, fixed broadband plans and prices, household and individual internet access, and infocomm industry revenue. The same portal holds a GeoJSON layer of Wireless@SG public wifi hotspot locations (about 1.7 MB). IMDA's own statistics page carries the current charts, last updated 26 June 2026: quarterly mobile, wireless broadband, residential and corporate wired broadband subscriptions and household broadband penetration for 2022 to 2025, monthly average mobile data usage in petabytes, and annual mobile penetration from 2015. Coverage: Singapore, national totals. Format and access: CSV and GeoJSON through the data.gov.sg API and download buttons, plus web charts, free under the Singapore Open Data Licence. Caveats: most portal series stop between 2019 and 2020 while the website continues only as charts; figures are national, with no breakdown by district or operator. Simulation uses: demand baselines and growth of mobile data traffic for capacity models, and hotspot locations for public connectivity layers. Related records: the OFCA communications open data for Hong Kong, the MCMC facts and figures for Malaysia and the ITU ICT statistics give comparable regulator series.
name: IMDA telecommunications statistics for Singapore: subscriptions, broadband, mobile data traffic and Wireless@SG hotspots
notes: data.gov.sg collections listed through the v2 API on 2026-09-26 (names, coverage dates, frequency, dataset formats and sizes). The IMDA statistics page renders its charts with scripts; chart titles and the last-updated date were read from the page source. The Wireless@SG layer's last update (2024-06-06 on the portal) is a portal migration date, not necessarily the data date.
provider: Infocomm Media Development Authority of Singapore (IMDA)
